model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a certain threshold after gating, as well as sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, with numerical labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1.0, with labels at intervals of 0.2. The graph contains four lines: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate with an average of 0.33, a solid blue line representing the sparsity ratio after the gate with an average of 0.44, a dashed green line representing the sparsity ratio before the average gate, and a solid green line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate with an average of 0.33. The dashed blue line starts at 0.33 and decreases to around 0.25 between layers 0 and 5, then gradually decreases further to approximately 0.23 at layer 20. The solid blue line begins at 0.33, dips slightly below 0.2 around layer 5, and then gradually rises to about 0.28 by layer 20. The dashed and solid green lines largely overlap, starting at 0.33 and decreasing sharply to around 0.25 by layer 5, before continuing a gradual decline to approximately 0.23 by layer 20.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph in Figure 5 (left) compares the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with different metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 in intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity ratio" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1 in intervals of 0.2. The graph contains four lines: a blue dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.63", a blue solid line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", a green dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before average gate, avg 0.63", and a green solid line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". The blue dashed and green dashed lines start at approximately 0.63 on the y-axis at x=0 and decrease to approximately 0.52 and 0.50 respectively at x=20. The blue solid line starts at approximately 0.32 on the y-axis at x=0, decreases to 0.28 at around x=5, and then increases to 0.44 at x=20. The green solid line starts at approximately 0.32 at x=0, decreases to 0.22 at around x=5, and then increases to 0.33 at x=20.

The x-axis is labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity ratio", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines: a dashed blue line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.91, which starts at approximately 0.44 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.32 at layer 5, and then remains steady until layer 20; a solid blue line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average value of 0.44, which begins at about 0.44 at layer 0, drops to roughly 0.33 at layer 5, and then remains relatively stable until layer 20; a dashed green line representing the "sparsity ratio at average gate" with an average value of 0.33, which starts at approximately 0.33 at layer 0 and remains steady until layer 20; and no other lines are clearly visible or described in the legend.

The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity ratio" and ranges from 0 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The diagram contains four lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.63, a blue solid line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average value of 0.44, a green dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before average gate" with an average value of 0.53, and a green solid line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average value of 0.33. The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.53 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.38 at layer 20. The blue solid line begins at about 0.47 at layer 0 and decreases to roughly 0.27 at layer 20. The green dashed line commences at approximately 0.43 at layer 0 and declines to around 0.32 at layer 20, while the green solid line starts at about 0.38 at layer 0 and drops to roughly 0.23 at layer 20.
